_source: DOMINION slice D15 (Many regions): design Part 5 §2-6 (Stability, Holders, betrayal, Boons, starting again), Part 9 A11 (three kinds of betrayal), A12 (standing orders), A13 (the one you bring remembers), Part 0 §6.1 Q3 (no money carries) and Q7 (only the Boss's ace comes, pre-evolved, at the Warehouse cap 15); mockup v4 s10 (the Empire across regions). Numbers are starting values, none playtested. The towns, targets, Gyms and rivals of each region are in regions/<id>.json (tools/dominion/regions-to-json.py).
openNote: First release: Kanto, Johto and Hoenn play. The six newer regions (Sinnoh to Paldea) are built and validated but switched off (director, 2026-11-18); they open with the Crossing (D16) and Six.

boons.name: Silph tech
boons.text: Start each new region with a Garage and 10 Ultra Balls.

boons.name: Radio Tower
boons.text: Morning Report news +1 line; Spread the Word free once a week.

boons.name: Weather Institute
boons.text: Choose the weather in one district a week.
boons.note: Dominion jobs have no weather yet: the chosen district gets fair skies, +10% on every job there until the week ends.

boons.name: Aether foundation
boons.note: The Infirmary is free. Ultra Beast actions aren't in the Dominion action lists yet: Ultra Beast Incursions stay a main-game event.

lines.ace: {ace} came along. It's a {species} again, Lv {level}: it remembers every fight, even if its body doesn't.
lines.aceSame: {ace} came along as it is, Lv {level}.
lines.noAce: The Boss came alone. The team stays to guard the old HQ.
lines.brought: {name} came with you. They kept everything.
lines.nobody: Nobody came with you. Every member stayed behind with the Holder.
lines.garage: Silph tech: a Garage is already standing, and 10 Ultra Balls wait in the Bag.
lines.fame: Word travels: in {region} they call you {word}.

why.self: Stability can't fall below 50 and nobody betrays you. You must travel back (2 days) at least once every 14 days, or Stability −20.
why.member: Uses their Wits and traits; you stay focused on the new region. Betrayal risk comes from Ambition and Loyalty.
why.usurped: +20 Stability: the region knows them. The highest betrayal risk: they remember losing.

options.name: Maximise income
options.line: {holder} squeezed every till in {region}.

options.name: Build for the long term
options.line: {holder} put {region}'s money back into the rackets.

options.name: Save for construction
options.line: {holder} is saving for a new building in {region}.

options.name: Keep a reserve
options.line: {holder} kept a reserve in {region}'s safe.

options.name: Cut costs
options.line: {holder} cut wages in {region}. Nobody thanked them.

options.name: Recruit hard
options.line: {holder} signed up new faces in {region}.

options.name: Train who we have
options.line: {holder} drilled the {region} crew all week.

options.name: Pay well
options.line: {holder} paid the {region} crew well. They noticed.

options.name: More security
options.line: {holder} doubled the guards in {region}.

options.name: Let the Holder decide
options.line: {holder} ran {region}'s people their own way.

options.name: Win the locals (Regard)
options.line: {holder} handed out favours on every corner of {region}.

options.name: Spread out
options.line: {holder} pushed into a new town in {region}.

options.name: Buy businesses
options.line: {holder} bought another shop in {region}.

options.name: Crush resistance
options.line: {holder} broke up a rebel meeting in {region}. Loudly.

options.name: Court the Gyms and League
options.line: {holder} took a Gym Leader to dinner in {region}.

options.name: Defend holdings
options.line: {holder} kept every holding in {region} guarded.

options.name: Hunt spies
options.line: {holder} turned {region}'s HQ inside out looking for moles.

options.name: Stop the rival growing
options.line: {holder} kept the rivals in {region} small.

options.name: Watch the old team
options.line: {holder} kept an eye on the old team's people in {region}.

options.name: Guard key buildings
options.line: {holder} put guards on {region}'s key buildings.

readings.line: {holder} read "Maximise income" the hard way: every shop in {region} pays twice, and nobody smiles.
{holder} wouldn't cut anyone's pay in {region}. "They're family, Boss."
{holder} took in strays in {region} instead of strangers. Nobody's left out.
{holder} enjoyed crushing the resistance in {region} a bit too much.
{holder} tried to win {region} with favours. It came out sounding like threats.
{holder} only buys shops in {region} that fit the Goal.
{holder} went after the rivals in {region} personally.
{holder} "watched" the old team in {region}. Quietly, they protected its name.

secession.name: Secession
secession.text: {holder} declared {region} theirs. Your old HQ, the loyal members and the rackets are a rival team now.
secession.answer: The Long Trip: go back and retake it, or let it go.

sellout.name: The Sellout
sellout.text: {holder} sold you to the police in {region}: Wanted there +50. They keep running it, quietly.

coup.name: The Coup
coup.text: {holder} is going for the whole empire and has written to your other Holders.
coup.answer: The Long Talk: Debate each Holder in turn, or crush the one who started it.

lines.selfMissed: You haven't been back to {region} in {days} days. Stability −20.
lines.unrest: Unrest in {region}: a town slipped away ({towns} left).
lines.revolt: Revolt in {region}! {n} towns lost; no tribute until it calms.
lines.uprising: An Uprising in {region}: the Gyms and the rebels moved together. Stability −10.
lines.newHero: A new hero rose in {region}: {hero}. Stability −12.
lines.cracked: The Shadow cracked in {region}: Wanted passed 60. Three towns are lost.
lines.coupRoll: {holder} got the letter from {from}. They're thinking about it.
lines.lost: {region} is lost. Owning every region needs it back.
lines.visit: You spend two days in {region}. {holder} looks relieved to see you, or acts it. Stability +10.
lines.visitAway: The Boss is still away visiting a held region. The crew runs the Day here.
lines.pay: {holder} gets a raise and a new title. Betrayal risk falls.
lines.replace: {old} is out; {holder} holds {region} now. Half of {old}'s people stay.
lines.spy: A spy is in {holder}'s HQ in {region}. Their risk band shows: {band}.
lines.talk: The Long Talk with {holder} is set for the Leader's Table.
lines.talkDone: {holder} heard you out. Their risk is halved.
lines.swap: {holder} takes over {region}; the trip takes 3 days, and {old} hands over the keys.
lines.noTalk: The Long Talk opens at risk 60. {holder} isn't there yet, as far as you can tell.
lines.noRegion: That region isn't yours to act on.
lines.notEvening: Holders are swapped in the Evening.
lines.reclaimOpen: The Long Trip: retake {region} from {traitor}. Control starts at 40%.
lines.reclaimWon: {region} is back. {traitor} is finished; Stability resets to 60.
lines.letGo: You let {region} go. It stays lost.
lines.leaveNotYet: You can leave once {region} is Taken (the Hero beaten).
lines.lastRegion: Every region in the run is yours. The ending waits (D17).
lines.boonSpread: Radio Tower: Spread the Word is free this week.
lines.boonWalk: Plasma's network: {name} walked in, sent by an old friend.
lines.boonSkies: Weather Institute: fair skies over {district} this week (+10% on jobs).
lines.magmaCool: Magma stands down for now: Magma Tension −{n}, and Aqua's goes up {n}.
lines.aquaCool: Aqua stands down for now: Aqua Tension −{n}, and Magma's goes up {n}.
lines.sentTwo: {names} ship out to {region}. The Holder has more hands; the crew here has fewer.
lines.sentNone: Nobody here can be spared for {region}.
lines.tributeCut: The held regions keep more of their money: tribute −{n}% from now on.
lines.smuggle: A smuggling line now runs between your regions: tribute +{n}% while one is held.
lines.uprisingCut: The Gym union stands aside: Uprising odds −{n}% in Monarch regions.
lines.uprisingUp: The Gym union walks out angry: Uprising odds +{n}%.

tells: All quiet in {region}, Boss. The lads have been painting the warehouse. New colours. Thought it'd be a nice surprise.
{holder}'s weekly report from {region} came three days late, and it's half a page.
The tribute from {region} came short again. "Bad week," says the note. It doesn't say who wrote it.
The new recruits in {region} salute {holder}, not the Boss.
{holder} has been calling the {region} crew "my people" on the phone.
A spy's tip from {region}: {holder} had dinner with someone from the police.

arrive: Just like old times, Boss. Except this time I know what I'm doing.
{region}. Never been. Bet the {rival} lot are louder than {oldRival} were.
New warehouse, same leaks. I'll find the buckets.
compare: {oldRival} at least paid their grunts. This lot, I'm not sure.
{oldHero} would've been here by now. {hero}'s slower. Or smarter.
name: {old} would've liked it here. Shame they stayed in {oldRegion}.
Wonder how {old} is getting on in {oldRegion}.
warn: Last time we did this, {old} got caught.
We tried this in {oldRegion}. It went sideways on day two.

leave.title: Leaving {region}
leave.bringNote: One member, any rank. They keep everything. Everyone else stays with the Holder.
leave.aceNote: Your team stays to guard the old HQ. Only {ace} comes, as {pre}, Lv 15.
leave.noMoney: Money doesn't cross regions: you arrive with ₽1,000.
